research_result.description: SE Ranking provides comprehensive SEO, AI search visibility, and SERP data through REST APIs and a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can obtain an API key directly from the account dashboard under the API Dashboard section. A single API key grants access to both Data and Project API endpoints. A 14-day free trial offering 100,000 API credits is available self-serve without requiring a credit card, after which usage requires a paid plan or pay-as-you-go credit purchase.

evidence.claim: SE Ranking provides a REST API for integration and programmatic data access.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: SE Ranking doesn’t currently offer first-party SDKs and integration is done via the REST API reference and a Postman collection for endpoint testing.

evidence.claim: Data API endpoints are authenticated using an API key via an Authorization header or query parameter.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: First, you’ll need to generate a unique API key from your account dashboard.

evidence.claim: A single API key authorizes access across both Project API and Data API endpoints.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: A single API key authorizes every endpoint across the Project API and the Data API.

evidence.claim: SE Ranking offers an MCP server providing tools across SEO, backlinks, domain research, and AI visibility.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: SE Ranking MCP gives Claude, Cursor, and any compatible AI tool direct access to 180+ research tools with keyword data, backlinks, domain analysis, AI search visibility, and competitor analysis.

evidence.claim: The MCP server supports OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and API key authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Streamable HTTP transport with OAuth 2.1 + PKCE and dynamic client registration, or an X-Api-Key header for headless use.

evidence.claim: A self-serve 14-day free trial with 100,000 credits and MCP access is available.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The 14-day free trial gives you 100K API credits across all six API endpoints, as well as MCP server access.
